label: Roman rule ends
note: The Romano-British depose Roman officials around 410; Honorius refuses Britain help.
article: End of Roman rule in Britain

label: Germanus visits
note: Bishop Germanus of Auxerre visits Britain to combat Pelagianism.

label: Hengist and Horsa (legend)
note: The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, compiled from the 9th century, dates their arrival to 449.

label: Ælle lands (legend)
note: The Chronicle's foundation story of Sussex.

label: Badon
note: A British victory; proposed dates include 493, 501 and 516.

label: Gildas writes
note: Usually dated to the 540s, now thought quite possibly earlier.

label: The dust veil
note: An eruption cools the northern hemisphere for several years.

label: Plague of Justinian
note: Plague victims at Edix Hill near Cambridge show it reached Britain.

label: Ida in Bernicia
note: Said to have taken the kingdom about 547.

label: Catraeth
note: The Gododdin attack Catraeth, perhaps Catterick, around 600.

label: Paulinus at Yeavering
note: Bede: 36 days of preaching and baptism at the royal vill.
